item.content:encoded:
Note: If you're going to introduce yourself here, please scroll down and click "New Post" and NOT "reply", otherwise your comment will nest incorrectly!

Hello, readers and reviewers of the Foundation Universe!

This month's random question is: what kind of random thoughts keep you up at night?

Let's start off with some things to take a look at to enhance your reading, now that you're a site member:

  • If you have any questions about the Foundation'verse and its various individuals and groups of interest, head over to the Foundation Universe forum to talk about the various aspects of living/working/being in constant fear of a world where anomalies are real.
  • Did you know our site has a night mode version? If you're interested in that (and a few other neat things!), check out our Usertools page.
  • Want to leave a comment or read others' thoughts on something you've read recently? Scroll down to the bottom of that page you read, click the "Discuss" link, and take a look at the comments others have posted!

For those looking to put your knowledge of the SCP-verse to work and contribute to the site by helping develop works-in-progress, head on over to the Writing Help forums!

  • So you want to be a concept reviewer?
  • So you want to be a draft reviewer?
  • And of course, remember the Criticism Policy!

If you're not sure what to talk about here, you can take a look at our How to Write an Intro/Welcome thread for ideas.

Go ahead and respond to other new members if you find that your interests overlap, and definitely ask for reading suggestions if there's a particular kind of SCP article or tale you enjoy reading. If you're looking to get started as a critiquer, feel free to mention the kind of material you particularly want to see more of on the wiki! You might even see some of our authors drop by here from time to time, if you mention you liked their work! :)

Welcome to the site!

Note: If you're going to introduce yourself here, please scroll down and click "New Post" and NOT "reply", otherwise your comment will nest incorrectly!

Hello, new site members/artists/gamers/social media watchers/roleplayers/etc.!

This month's random question is: what kind of random thoughts keep you up at night?

Here's some places to talk to get you all started off, now that you've arrived:

  • Games and Hobbies forum: Just started playing a new game or are wondering if any other SCP site members play your favorite game? Alternatively, wondering if anyone else paints minifigures or goes to conventions? Jump into the conversations here.
  • Media Discussion forum: Have a cool video or news article that just screams of the paranormal? Talk about it and other such things here!
  • Fan Work forum: Have a cool drawing or want to see the work of some of the other artists here? Have an SCP-based mod or board game in the works? This is the place to discuss!

If you're not sure what to talk about here, you can take a look at our How to Write an Intro/Welcome thread for ideas.

Have fun mingling with the other new arrivals and talking about your interests, hobbies, and plans for taking over the universe. You might also see some of our veteran users here from time to time, since you never know when someone might be looking for an artist or a voice actor or an idea-haver for the next big collaboration article or SCP project! Talk and be merry. :)

Welcome to the site!

item.content:encoded:
Note: If you're going to introduce yourself here, please scroll down and click "New Post" and NOT "reply", otherwise your comment will nest incorrectly!

Hello, prospective site writers! It's good to see you here!

This month's random question is: what kind of random thoughts keep you up at night?

First off, a couple standard things to keep in mind as you get started towards adding your voice to the Foundation universe:

  • Definitely read the How to Write an SCP Guide and the pages in the Guide Hub that are relevant to your ideas!
  • Make a sandbox page for your works in progress, reference notes, inspirational snippets, and more author things!
  • Get familiar with our three Writing Help Forums:
    • Questions Desk: For all your questions about the writing process!
    • Ideas and Brainstorming: For asking about concepts that you're thinking of writing up! This is an especially important step for first-time authors!
    • Drafts and Critiques: For reviews of your finished pieces, to see what edits need to be made to your work to make it ready for the mainlist!

If you're not sure what to talk about here, you can take a look at our How to Write an Intro/Welcome thread for ideas.

Feel free to respond to other new members if you find that your writing interests and/or plans overlap. The SCP wiki is a collaborative writing community, after all! You might even see some of the longtime writers here drop by with comments now and then. :)

Welcome to the site!

item.content:encoded:
Hello. I am The Dark Alakazam. I joined because I had a particular SCP idea that I think has great potential and I would like to get realized, whether I be the one who writes it in its entirety, or maybe perhaps pass off the torch to someone else. I am looking forward to getting started, although I think right now most of my energy will be spent writing my finals instead of writing on forums, although I imagine this won't last forever

I've also spent time writing a personal book series, involving fantasy and sci fi themes, and I'm sure this site will be able to give great ideas for that, as well.

Of the classical elements (fire, water, air, earth), which represents you the most, and why?
Probably water, I am very go with the flow, and I would rather watch and wait before taking action.

item.title: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Hello, I go by the name BreakerBreaker (or just Breaker for short). I'm very glad I finally joined the wiki. I've been (somewhat) active on the Site-42 discord for about a month, I've been an SCP fan-artist for a little longer than that, and have been a fan of the wiki for almost a year now. I figured it was time to further join the SCP community. I do plan on becoming a writer on the wiki. I've already drafted my first greenlight request, which I hope to post on the Ideas Critique forum soon.

I have a lot of hobbies, but my primary one's are reading, writing, robotics, martial arts, and art. I'm occasionally a very outdoorsy person who likes hiking and camping, except when I don't. Then I flee from sunlight and barricade myself indoors to play video games.

Of the classic elements, I think fire definitely represents me the most. I find myself to be a very passionate person which fire certainly symbolizes the most. And, honestly, fire is just cool in general.

item.title: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Explorers: Re: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Explorers
item.content:encoded:
Hello everyone!

My name is Lukas and I'm from germany. I first discovered the site many years ago, when I watched some YouTube creepypasta videos. I thought the idea of this wiki was fascinating and continued to go down the rabbit hole of this website.

I probably want to contribute to the site by voting (of course) and actually writing some articles. I had an idea for a SCP for quite some time now, but after reading some documents on this site, I want to give it some more time, since my idea seems to be one hard to write about (it's a supernatural humanoid). Also, my punctuation is more of a work-in-progress at this point in time. However, I am certain i can improve. I will also need to learn the proper coding for the Wikidot syntax.

Well, no matter how long it will take for me to publish my first article, I will certainly be on the lookout for new SCPs and opportunities to give new and old writers some good-hearted critique/feedback.

I am looking forward to working with you all!

P.S.: For the question of the month, I think I have to go with water. I'm normally very still, but a single drop will bring me into motion. If the motion is good or bad?… Well, only time will tell. After all, it depends on where the waves will move me.

item.title: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Hello there, ManyCaps. Welcome to the SCP Wiki!

If you've got an idea you're interested in, it's always a good idea to run it through the Ideas Critique Forum to get it greenlit and to overall get help in fleshing out and developing the concept as a whole. Additionally, seeing that you're interested in becoming a writer for the site, it's a good idea to read around and check out some of the newer articles to gauge what people are interested in these days. I personally recommend SCP-5858. Anyway, here's some resources to help you out:

◎ Open Resources ◎
◉ Close Resources ◉

If you're going to try your hand at writing, try out our sandbox. You can make yourself a page here to store your drafts.

Sandbox

For hashing out concepts, try out the Ideas and Brainstorming forum. You can run your ideas by the community if you need help refining your concept.

If you have a draft ready, make a thread in the Drafts and Critiques forum. Remember to check the stickied posts in the relevant thread for guidelines on how best to use each forum. You can also try the IRC chat for real-time feedback.

From site usage to writing tips, the Guide Hub contains a wealth of resources geared towards helping members produce successful articles.

The more time you take to familiarize yourself with the SCP style, the drafting process, and the community, the greater your chances are for success!

As far as reading is concerned, you might want to check out our Top Rated New Pages, which will display the most popular, recent articles. It's helpful to keep up with what's being received well by the community.

With that said, I hope you enjoy your time here.

Hello everyone.

I go by RottenLB, and I decided to finally join the site after several years of finding an SCP reference on reddit, going "Oh, that site exists", reading a few of them and forgetting again.

Well, I read a lot more this time around, and decided that I would like to try my hand at writing one too. I'm not sure if I'll ever post something to the mainsite, but I'd like to go through the greenlighting/drafting process and see.

item.title: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Good Evening, all.

I'm DiamondFriday98, and I'm an aspiring fiction writer from the UK, as well as being a practising copy-writer. I am currently working on a remote placement year for a magazine company in China producing articles, proofreading and editing their English-language content. Aside from that I am studying in university on a Media Communications course.

I'm here on the SCP wiki both because the setting and entries have interested me for a long time, to destress from my usual job and recapture the joy of writing for it's own sake. I struggle with having few people close to me to show my work, or adequate motivation & formatting to keep my attention. I think the format of the SCP wiki, it's articles and whatnot will help me recapture my desire to write.

If (correct me if I'm wrong) we're supposed to answer the 'random question' in our posts, I'd say that I'm closest to Air, I tend to have a low attention span, moving from one subject/hobby to another constantly. I can strongly embrace them and then immediately evaporate, but I like to think I can always return to them.

I hope you'll all enjoy having me and we'll be able to constructively discuss each other's work and the world of the SCP wiki! And if necessary I may repost this in the upcoming month's thread as we only have about a day before December.
